lines.text: Jesus left Judea for Galilee, passed through Samaria, and sat weary by Jacob's well in Sychar.
Jesus asked a Samaritan woman for a drink, and she was surprised because Jews do not associate with Samaritans.
Jesus told the woman to call her husband, said she had had five husbands, and she called Him a priest.
Jesus told the woman He was the Messiah, and she left her water jar and asked the townspeople about Him.
Many Samaritans believed because of the woman's testimony, then asked Jesus to stay seven days.
